headline: Two women drown in pond at Jagannath University's second campus
summary: The victims, aged 14 and 20, were bathing when the incident occurred in the Teghria area of Keraniganj on Monday afternoon.
details: Two women drowned in a pond located at the second campus of Jagannath University in the Teghria area of Keraniganj on Monday afternoon.
The deceased have been identified as Julia, 20, the wife of local resident Shafiqul Islam, and Rabeya, 14, the daughter of Atiqur Rahman.
According to Inspector (Investigation) Abul Kalam Azad of the South Keraniganj Police Station, four women had entered the pond to bathe together, but two of them drowned.
Local residents recovered the bodies of the two women from the water. Police have stated that legal processes regarding the incident are currently underway.
Following the tragedy, Jagannath University Vice-Chancellor Raish Uddin announced that the university has issued a notice restricting public access to the pond.
The university's notice warns that legal action will be taken against anyone entering the pond or the ghats without permission.
caption:
Two women, aged 14 and 20, drowned while bathing in a pond at Jagannath University's second campus.

Two women drowned in a pond located at the second campus of Jagannath University in the Teghria area of Keraniganj on Monday afternoon.

The deceased have been identified as Julia, 20, the wife of local resident Shafiqul Islam, and Rabeya, 14, the daughter of Atiqur Rahman.

According to Inspector (Investigation) Abul Kalam Azad of the South Keraniganj Police Station, four women had entered the pond to bathe together, but two of them drowned.

Local residents recovered the bodies of the two women from the water. Police have stated that legal processes regarding the incident are currently underway.

Following the tragedy, Jagannath University Vice-Chancellor Raish Uddin announced that the university has issued a notice restricting public access to the pond.

The university's notice warns that legal action will be taken against anyone entering the pond or the ghats without permission.

headline: Dhaka's small traders squeezed by extortion from criminal groups
summary: Businesses in Mirpur and other parts of the capital are facing intense pressure from multiple gangs demanding illegal payments.
details: Small traders across Dhaka are reporting a surge in extortion demands, creating a severe financial burden on their businesses.
caption:
